definitions.gloss: possessiveness; desire to monopolize; jealous desire to have someone or something all to oneself
definitions.explanation: A strong desire to have exclusive possession of a person, thing, or resource. Most commonly used about romantic possessiveness, but can also apply to material things or attention.

examples.japanese: {独占欲|どくせんよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{恋人|こいびと}→恋人：02724_koibito⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{独占欲|どくせんよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えられない→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: I can't control my possessiveness toward my partner.

examples.japanese: {独占欲|どくせんよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかなくなる。
examples.english: If you're too possessive, your relationships won't go well.

notes:
USAGE:
{独占欲|どくせんよく} is a compound of ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧ (monopoly) and ⟦{欲|よく}→欲：13183_yoku⟧ (desire). In everyday conversation it most often refers to romantic jealousy and possessiveness, but it can also describe a desire to monopolize resources, attention, or opportunities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独占欲|どくせんよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (to be possessive)
- {独占欲|どくせんよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ (to control one's possessiveness)
- {独占欲|どくせんよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かられる (to be driven by possessiveness)
